variety_description: High yielding, mid-early maturity, medium height, medium slender variety suitable for transplanting under rainfed lowland conditions. A short duration and drought tolerant variety developed by BINA and released in 2015 for planting in Aman season in drought prone areas. Require less input. Tolerant to major diseases and insect pests
